historical_reviews.deepseek: Its readings are useful supporting samples, but a name grep can omit valid sensors and dynamic values cannot be compared without synchronized context and units.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Memory-used and utilization are workload telemetry, not necessarily BMC hardware sensors; every BMC label must be mapped explicitly instead of assuming field equivalence.

original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC GPU Sensors view reports the specified sensor set and correct values/status for every installed GPU under a documented operating context.
original_method: Establish the SUT/BMC/GPU map and owner sensor specification, record workload, ambient and timestamp, capture the complete BMC Web Sensors page or approved API, full IPMI sensor inventory and per-GPU NVIDIA readings, then correlate each label/value/status by stable identity and compare units, ranges, freshness and expected availability without changing any control.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the expected sensor names, units, ranges, tolerances and context; an operator verifies the target/BMC page while automation gathers synchronized protected read-only evidence.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC and complete GPU UUID/PCIe/slot map
BMC Sensors labels and documented API mapping
Units, normal/critical ranges, status meanings and tolerances
Sampling interval, freshness limit, ambient and workload context
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, fan curves, clocks, power limits or workload
Do not expose passwords, tokens, serials or endpoint identity
Do not assume GPU index or sensor-name substring is complete
Capture timestamps and full raw output
Stop on thermal alarm, missing/stale sensor or identity/unit ambiguity
Preserve SEL/kernel/GPU history and do not clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, GPU and sensor maps
Collect full IPMI and per-GPU NVIDIA readings with timestamps
Correlate units/status/freshness and compare to owner matrix
Report findings without mutation or formal verdict
engineer_actions: Provide the authoritative sensor matrix and acceptance ranges
Interpret unsupported, stale or alarm states

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: nvidia-smi and IPMI provide relevant corroboration, but unsafe sshpass, a narrow GPU grep, absent timestamps and no BMC Web view or specification matrix make the YES conclusion incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture the full BMC GPU Sensors view/API, complete IPMI sensor inventory and protected per-GPU NVIDIA telemetry with stable UUID/PCIe identity and near-synchronized timestamps, then compare only mapped fields to the owner matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Sensors page, SPEC comparison and 10/10-minute estimates remain; no stress or control write is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each stable GPU identity, record the complete expected BMC sensor set with value, unit, status and age, alongside the closest IPMI/NVIDIA sample and context, then explicitly flag unsupported or non-equivalent fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds completeness, identity, time, unit and freshness checks while retaining the source's read-only BMC inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS telemetry cannot replace the BMC Web view, and filtered IPMI output cannot prove all required sensors exist; cross-surface values may differ because of sampling latency or semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dynamic readings can legitimately diverge during workload transitions, while a stale plausible value can conceal telemetry failure unless freshness is checked.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the required BMC sensor list, mapping and tolerances and whether an API is equivalent to the Web page. Missing NVSM is irrelevant unless the specification explicitly requires it for this sensor case.
expected_evidence: Verified target and GPU UUID/PCIe/slot mapping, sensor matrix, units/ranges/status/freshness rules
Timestamped ambient, workload and power context
Full protected IPMI inventory and per-GPU NVIDIA telemetry with exit status
Thermal/GPU/kernel/SEL evidence, no-mutation/security audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for BMC GPU sensor information to match the specification. DeepSeek provides incomplete corroboration but no conflicting source objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sensor matrix, mapping, context and packages are normal project inputs; the read-only BMC sensor-validation purpose is clear.

review_improvement: Restores complete BMC coverage and adds the identity, unit, freshness and context controls necessary to judge dynamic GPU telemetry instead of accepting a filtered list of plausible numbers.
independent_technical_reasoning: A sensor result is meaningful only with target, unit, status, timestamp and operating context. GPU temperature can change within seconds, while BMC and driver paths may sample at different rates; therefore exact equality is not generally valid. Completeness and approved tolerance/freshness, rather than a substring match, determine whether the BMC view satisfies its specification.
